svg.title: Stanford k1: preliminary grid-80 evidence
svg.desc: Preliminary grid-80 view: no completed grid-120 evidence or final two-grid report. Spatial verification is unavailable; a completed mesh-80 curve does not establish it. Three panels show measured voltage and skin temperature, DFN grid-80 predicted voltage and volume-average temperature, and signed predicted-minus-measured voltage residuals on each model's actual observed overlap. Every curve ends at its own recorded endpoint. No source sample is added in 0 <= t < 1.0006 seconds. Initial and post-source current continuations are declared input hypotheses, not measurements. The grid-80 electrical empirical gate is FAIL; the 80-to-120 spatial numerical check is UNAVAILABLE. These are separate conclusions. Thermal-proxy gates are FAIL. Thermal qualification is not established: measured skin and predicted volume average are different observables, and h=15 W/m2/K is an unidentified fixture hypothesis. ORegan empirical failures remain 30/36; no whole-cohort or full-model validation. Scores come unchanged from mesh80-report.json. RMSE thresholds are aggregate criteria, not pointwise confidence/tolerance bands; no such band is drawn. Display compression retains actual first/min/max/last samples in 120 equal-time bins independently per series; no smoothing or new samples. The initial-time inset is unreduced. Full numeric CSVs/workbook remain unchanged. Data: Edoardo Catenaro, Simona Onori; DOI 10.17632/kxsbr4x3j2.2; CC-BY-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes to source presentation: time in commanded discharge-step seconds, temperature displayed in degrees Celsius, display compression and model overlay.
